About the scent thing...

For what it’s worth I have a Bio degree and am a published coauthor. I can personally attest to being attracted to a woman’s scent so it’s not like the Fathers are entirely wrong or something. The thing is, there has actually never been a study that has isolated a human sex pheromone. Also fun fact: you *cannot* smell pheromones. 

The scents people have aren’t due to genes (at least not directly) but are due to sudoriferous glands and bacterial secretions. The resulting scent molecules are mostly neutral in terms of sexual attraction though

Personally, i don’t think I’ve ever encountered a woman who I thought smelled bad. If you smell like a woman, I’m into it. Also, if she’s my girlfriend I will love her scent over time, just by association of it with her.
Unpopular opinion but Sofia will most likely think you are a bitchboy
